description: Estaciones de Gas Natural Vehicular y Carga Eléctrica – EPM is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by E.S.P. Empresas Públicas de Medellín - EPM, Antioquia. Las EDS son estaciones de servicio de Gas Natural Vehicular – GNV marca propia EPM, en las que los usuarios de este combustible pueden ir a tanquear sus vehículos. En estas estaciones el suministro de gasolina no es de EPM, solo incluye la parte de la estación que vende exclusivamente GNV. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher E.S.P. Empresas Públicas de Medellín - EPM, Antioquia. Its tags are vehículos eléctricos, epm., gas, estaciones, vehiculos. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Minas y Energía. The portal shows 2025-07-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
